### Instruction:
What is the difference between fine-tuning and prompt engineering?

### Response:
Prompt engineering shapes model behavior at inference time without changing weights. Fine-tuning updates model weights on domain-specific data, yielding deeper specialization at the cost of compute and data preparation.
expected: Prompt engineering shapes model behavior at inference time without changing weights. Fine-tuning updates model weights on domain-specific data, yielding deeper specialization at the cost of compute and data preparation.
